package answer

import "context"

type PracticeTaskRuntimeBridge interface {
	BindAnswer(ctx context.Context, userID, taskID, answerID, sandboxID string, previewURL *string) error
	FinalizeAnswer(ctx context.Context, answerID string, passed bool, rawResult map[string]any, fileStorageID *string, sandboxID, previewURL *string) error
}

func isPracticeTaskRuntimeTask(task *TaskMetadata) bool {
	if task == nil {
		return false
	}
	return task.IsPracticeTaskRuntime
}
